description.en: A Mosasaurus missouriensis reconstruction with a robust head, elongated trunk, four paddles and a compressed swimming tail. Tail-fin skin, soft tissues and colour are inferred from comparative evidence, not a complete single specimen.
description.zh: Mosasaurus missouriensis的完整复原，具有粗壮头部、长躯、四桨肢与侧扁游泳尾。尾鳍皮肤、软组织和颜色依据比较证据推定，并非单个完整标本。

evidence_anchors.body: FalkenXIX photograph TMP2008.036.0001 actually viewed: authentic partial articulated skull, neck/ribcage and limb elements,10cm photo scale. Tail not preserved in this image; not called complete body. Comparative same-species support only, two individuals kept distinct.
evidence_anchors.head: Bloopityboop2020 original TMP2012.010.0001 skull photo actually viewed, Commons metadata names specimen and original not cast. Long toothed rostrum, substantial posterior skull/jaws; bone injury not genus character. Museum2020factsheet independently identifies KoriteM.missouriensis with embedded tooth.
evidence_anchors.scale: Konishi,Scott,Brown,Brink,Brinkman2026 CSVPabstract p49 explicitly calls TMP2012.010.0001 virtually complete adult M.missouriensis,~6.5m and90cm skull. Original abstract-volumePDF stored and relevantpageviewed.
evidence_anchors.tail: Lindgren et al2010 Platecarpus natural tail bend and regionalization, already acquired originalPDF copied self-contained. Related-taxon inference, no direct M.missouriensis soft-tissue fin claimed.

morphology: Robust elongated monitorlike head with substantial rear jaw muscle region, widening behind long tapering snout; head about14%total. Fleshed rear skull deep and broad enough to read as powerful reptile, not tiny-headed Platecarpus or needle-snouted ichthyosaur.

Pointed recurved conical marginal teeth begin near rostral tip; no long tooth-free Tylosaurus knob. Modest12degree gape. Simplified~14visibleteethperjawside is rendering convention, not a precise tooth formula. No unnaturally swollen giant shark gape.
Short neck smoothly joins elongated muscular ribcage, substantial but streamlined body. No exposed temporal holes or skeletal windows.
Four fleshed paddle limbs with distinct roots and tapered rounded distal margins, fore somewhat larger. No separated terrestrial fingers or turtle claws; no flat triangular sheets.

Long laterally compressed tail with proximal deepening, narrow peduncle and restrained hypocercal fin. Vertebral/lower lobe bends ventrally; upper soft-tissue lobe is explicit related-mosasaur inference. No horizontal whale fluke or back dorsal fin.
No crocodile scutes, fossil matrix or individual bite pathology baked into generic silhouette. Muted gray/olive back and pale belly artistic inference.

original_scope.en: Planned animal asset: robust monitorlike head on an elongated flipper-bearing trunk.
original_scope.zh: 规划中的动物资产：伸长鳍肢躯干上的粗壮巨蜥状头。

scale.interpretation: Total/head anchored to approximate author values; every other division and soft tissue width inferred. Do not import a17m M.hoffmannii estimate or juvenile specimen scale.

scientific_limits.en: Main scale/head anchorTMP2012.010.0001 is about6.5m with90cm skull in Konishi et al2026 conference abstract p49, not a full osteological monograph. Actual skull photograph viewed; full skeleton photo of this individual not obtained. Separate same-species TMP2008.036.0001 partial skull/trunk/limb fossil photograph supports body construction qualitatively, not adult proportions or a complete tail. Do not claim all photos same specimen or a single-specimen digital twin. Tail-fin skin and bilateral restoration inferred from related mosasaur anatomy, with preserved original head gate retained. Skeleton flattening, injury, jaw displacement and matrix not live shape. Soft tissue, volume, color and component lengths inferred.
scientific_limits.zh: 主要尺度和头骨锚TMP2012.010.0001在Konishi等2026会议摘要第49页为全长约6.5米、头90厘米，非完整骨学专著。已查看真头骨照片，未取得该个体全骨架图。另一同种TMP2008.036.0001局部头躯干肢骨照片仅定性补身体，不冒成体比例或完整尾证据；不称所有照片为同标本或数字孪生。尾鳍皮肤和双侧复原参考近缘沧龙类推定，原粗壮头形态保持。压扁、伤口、脱位及基质不照搬成活体。软组织、体积、颜色、细分尺寸推定。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole living Mosasaurus missouriensis: robust monitorlike head, elongated trunk, four paddles and laterally compressed swimming tail. Genus-level original ID retained; not a skull-only asset and not giant M.hoffmannii extrapolation.

acceptance: Front lateral shows deep posterior head and toothed rostrum without tooth-free knob.
Top shows clear cranial widening behind tapered snout, substantial elongated torso and four paddles.
Head-on side confirms volumetric jaw muscle region, not a thin skull plate.
Perspective preserves original robust-head/elongated-body gate and whole-tail extent at512preview.
shape_gate.comparisons: Tylosaurus comparator has conspicuous toothless blunt rostral knob; here teeth reach near tip and deeper wider posterior head. Platecarpus has proportionally smaller short head; do not merely enlarge/recolor its whole silhouette. Ichthyosaurus has needlelike rostrum, dominant eye and different caudal axis.
shape_gate.required_combination: Robust long toothed monitorlike head with strong posterior jaw region on elongated four-paddle swimming trunk. Full organism.
